maria.s: Quick check — onboarding Riptide9B v1. Uploaded weights to s3://redwood-models/riptide9b/v1/riptide9b.pt and pushed tokenizer files to gs://redwood-tokenizers/riptide9b/v1/. Can someone validate config and run a quick perf sweep?

T.J.: on it — pinging @olga.k for tokenizer quirks since last time we had empty-token returns on short prompts.

olga.k: saw that before — the riptide tokenizer has a regex that collapses trailing whitespace into a single token for some UTF-8 sequences. Quick workaround: set strip_whitespace: false in tokenizer config.

maria.s: thanks. current model_config.yaml I pushed:```
model: riptide9b
weights_path: s3://redwood-models/riptide9b/v1/riptide9b.pt
tokenizer: riptide_tok_v1
max_seq_len: 2048
batch_size: 8
quant: q3f
```

T.J.: batch_size 8 will probably OOM on our 24GB instances for seq 2048. Suggest run with batch_size 4 for perf smoke. Also add kv_cache: true if you want incremental decode workloads.

maria.s: updated config to batch_size: 4 and added strip_whitespace: false in tokenizer json. Pushed PR: https://git.internal/rip/onnx/PR-482 (ptal).

bench-bot: scheduled run #482: bench --model riptide9b --weights s3://redwood-models/riptide9b/v1/riptide9b.pt --batch 4 --seq 512 --iters 50 --device gpu0

bench-bot: run complete — summary: p50=52ms p90=113ms p95=160ms; avg throughput=180 tok/s per GPU; 95% mem usage ~ 22.8GB (stable). Logs: https://benchlogs/internal/482

T.J.: those numbers look fine for q3f on 24GB. Can you re-run with batch=2 seq=1024 to check tail latency?

bench-bot: queued run #483: batch 2 seq 1024 iters 30

bench-bot: run complete — summary: p50=86ms p90=220ms p95=310ms; avg throughput=120 tok/s per GPU; mem peak=23.4GB; occasional GC spikes noted in runtime logs.

olga.k: tokenizer patch fixed the empty-token issue on my local tests. One note: the tokenizer vocab includes an unusual control char at index 0 that causes off-by-one in our clipper; I filed a tiny sanitizer in PR-483 to drop control characters during pre-tokenize.

maria.s: awesome — thanks both. Next steps: 1) merge tokenizer sanitizer PR, 2) merge config change (batch 4 default), 3) update catalog entry with weights path + perf numbers + recommended instance type (g4dn-12?).

T.J.: for catalog note — pick instance with >=24GB GPU and add recommended batch 4 seq 512 for expected latency numbers. Also add fallback model variant riptide9b-int8 in case of capacity constraints.

maria.s: will prepare catalog draft. One last q: infra-bot, can you provision a short dedicated slot to run a longer 2h stability run tomorrow morning?

infra-bot: @maria.s -- reserved slot riptide9b-stability-2026-03-18-08 for 2h on pool-gpu-24gb. Ticket #INF-919 created.

T.J.: great. I'll review the PRs tonight. :thumbsup:

maria.s: thanks everyone — will post final catalog blurb here when merged. :sparkles:
